content:
Grouping on ordering codes (two models) and the overview’s explicit 10GBASE-ZR (10GbE-LAN) vs 10GBASE-ZW (10GbE-WAN) pairings. Transmit min 1528 nm applies to those 10G services; 1260 nm is only the receiver input range on the same module row, not a separate application mode. Global dispersion penalty is omitted (not in the output schema). `standards_code` matches each host interface; `bit_rate_gbps` 11.3 aligns with the 10G ZR/ZW interfaces (0.6 is the multirate floor, not a separate row).

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR | 10GBASE-ZR",
      "model": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1528.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ZR",
      "standards_code": "10GBASE-ZR",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.3
    },
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR | 10GBASE-ZW",
      "model": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1528.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ZW",
      "standards_code": "10GBASE-ZW",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.3
    },
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR-I | 10GBASE-ZR",
      "model": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR-I",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1528.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ZR",
      "standards_code": "10GBASE-ZR",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.3
    },
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR-I | 10GBASE-ZW",
      "model": "SO-SFP-10GE-ZR-I",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1528.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ZW",
      "standards_code": "10GBASE-ZW",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.3
    }
  ]
}
```
